course.title: Atomic – Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics — Stage 8

unit.title: Graphs
unit.blurb: Linear functions, tables of values and straight-line graphs, the gradient and y-intercept of y = mx + c, and real-life graphs.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Understand that a function is a relationship where each input has a single output, and find outputs and inputs.

O2.t: Complete tables of values and plot straight-line graphs, including lines parallel to the axes.

O3.t: Recognise the gradient and y-intercept in y = mx + c and find the gradient of a line.

O4.t: Read, interpret and draw graphs of real-life situations, including distance–time graphs.

p: In a function every input x has **exactly one** output y. y = 2x + 3: input 4 gives output 11.
A table of values lists inputs and outputs. If the outputs go up by the same amount each time, the function is **linear** and its graph is a straight line.

x = 4 is a VERTICAL line (every point has x-coordinate 4). y = 4 is horizontal.

p: In **y = mx + c**, m is the **gradient** (steepness) and c is the **y-intercept** (where the line crosses the y-axis).
Gradient = change in y ÷ change in x. A positive gradient slopes up to the right; a negative gradient slopes down.
